column1: # Source-to-target map consumed by setup.sh (the single source of truth).
# Columns (whitespace-separated; the label takes the rest of the line):
#   group   pacman | system | user   (setup.sh runs them in that order)
#           link:<guard>   user symlink, skipped unless <guard> exists
#           sudo-link      root-owned symlink; only for files never run by root
#           sudo-template  root-owned copy with @REPO_DIR@/@USER@/@HOME@ filled in
#   src     path relative to the repository
#   dest    absolute path, or ~/ for the invoking user's home
# Anything root reads or executes must be copied, never symlinked into the
# user-writable repository; re-run `archpostinstall sync-system` after edits.
# --- Package manager (installed before packages by bootstrap.sh) ---
# GUI-launched commands (GNOME shortcuts, zathura exec) do not see ~/.local/bin.
# Both are only ever run as the user, never by root.
# mkinitcpio archives resolved paths, so Plymouth must live at its real path.
system  sudo-copy      configs/mkinitcpio/linux-zen.preset                    /etc/mkinitcpio.d/linux-zen.preset                          Zen UKI Preset
user    link           scripts/gnome/backup_gnome_state.sh                    ~/.local/bin/archpostinstall-gnome-sync                     Gnome Sync Bin
